key_insights: Base case for 2023 is a harsh landing recession scenario with risk assets taking time to reprice and consolidate
Soft landing Goldilocks scenario is unlikely but would be very positive for risk assets if it occurs
Expect crypto to be range-bound for 2023 with volatility contraction at some point
Prefer trading at range extremes rather than midpoints
Dollar weakness has not led to risk asset strength, suggesting dollar strength would be very bearish
Relative strength strategy: long assets showing strength like LTC over weak ones
Yearly open fade strategy: look to fade large early-year impulses back toward the open

trading_ideas.entry: failed reclamation attempt outside pre-breakdown range
trading_ideas.speaker: Cred

summary: Cred expects 2023 to be a range-bound year for crypto following a harsh landing recession scenario. His base case is risk assets will take time to reprice through higher interest rates. Key levels for BTC are 14k support and 20k resistance, currently stuck in 16k-17.6k range. ETH shows relative strength above 1.1k but still has bearish weekly structure. He advocates trading range extremes, waiting for clear signals like reclaiming 20k for BTC or testing 12-14k support. Relative strength is the best approach among weak altcoins like LTC.
